'''Asha-Mu''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Voss (species)|Voss]] who served as an assistant to [[Orin-Va]], a healer at the [[Shrine of Healing]] on [[Voss]] at the time of the [[Galactic War]]. She and Orin-Va assisted the [[Voss Mystics|mystic-in-traing]] [[Gaden-Ko]] after he was poisoned by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Shendan]], and at the [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor's]] consent, Orin-Va used Voss techniques to share the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] life energy with the Voss.<ref name="Marked" />
